description: Cyber-Resilient Energy Infrastructure system is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Asad ullah. All research data, MATLAB codes, Figures are here. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
